tool:apply_preset.text0: Apply a develop preset (ids from cmd_presets_list) to the selection or `ids`, at `amount` percent (0..200, default 100).
tool:apply_preset.desc: Apply a develop preset (ids from cmd_presets_list) to the selection or `ids`, at `amount` percent (0..200, default 100).

tool:click.text0: Click a widget by automation id (`widget`, see list_widgets) or a screen point (`x`, `y`). `count: 2` double-clicks.
tool:click.desc: Click a widget by automation id (`widget`, see list_widgets) or a screen point (`x`, `y`). `count: 2` double-clicks.

tool:crop.text0: Set the crop of the active photo: `rect` [x0,y0,x1,y1] in normalized coordinates (0..1, origin top-left) of the straightened frame, `angle` in degrees. `reset: true` clears it. Give at least one of them.
tool:crop.desc: Set the crop of the active photo: `rect` [x0,y0,x1,y1] in normalized coordinates (0..1, origin top-left) of the straightened frame, `angle` in degrees. `reset: true` clears it. Give at least one of them.

tool:export.params: {bitDepth?:integer, colorSpace?:string, dir?:string, dontEnlarge?:boolean, format?:string, height?:integer, id?:integer, ids?:array, limitKb?:integer, longEdge?:integer, megapixels?:number, metadata?:string, naming?:string, path?:string, percent?:number, ppi?:integer, quality?:integer, removeLocation?:boolean, sharpen?:string, sharpenAmount?:string, shortEdge?:integer, startNumber?:integer, watermark?, width?:integer}
tool:export.text0: Render and write photos. Give `path` (one photo; format from the extension unless `format` is set) or `dir` (batch, file names from `naming`).
tool:export.desc: Render and write photos. Give `path` (one photo; format from the extension unless `format` is set) or `dir` (batch, file names from `naming`).

tool:get_develop.text0: The full develop settings JSON of a photo (white balance, light, color, curves, mixer, grading, effects, crop, masks, spots…).
tool:get_develop.desc: The full develop settings JSON of a photo (white balance, light, color, curves, mixer, grading, effects, crop, masks, spots…).

tool:import.text0: Add image/raw files to the library. Folders are scanned recursively for photos; relative paths resolve against the server's working directory. The first imported photo becomes active. Returns the new photo ids.
tool:import.desc: Add image/raw files to the library. Folders are scanned recursively for photos; relative paths resolve against the server's working directory. The first imported photo becomes active. Returns the new photo ids.

tool:inspect_ui.text0: UI state: view, open panel, window and image rects, active photo, selection, active mask, status, and `documents` [{title, dirty}] (the open library; dirty = unsaved changes).
tool:inspect_ui.desc: UI state: view, open panel, window and image rects, active photo, selection, active mask, status, and `documents` [{title, dirty}] (the open library; dirty = unsaved changes).

tool:list_commands.text0: Every command (engine + UI when connected) with id, label, menu, shortcut, parameter doc and whether it is enabled now. Each id is also callable as tool `cmd_<id with . replaced by _>` or via run_command.
tool:list_commands.desc: Every command (engine + UI when connected) with id, label, menu, shortcut, parameter doc and whether it is enabled now. Each id is also callable as tool `cmd_<id with . replaced by _>` or via run_command.

tool:list_controls.text0: Every develop slider (id like `light.exposure`, label, section, min, max, default, current value) for the active photo.
tool:list_controls.desc: Every develop slider (id like `light.exposure`, label, section, min, max, default, current value) for the active photo.

tool:list_widgets.text0: On-screen widgets by automation id with rects [x, y, w, h] in screen points.
tool:list_widgets.desc: On-screen widgets by automation id with rects [x, y, w, h] in screen points.

tool:pointer_gesture.text0: Replay a pointer gesture on the photo in normalized image coordinates (0..1, origin top-left): brush strokes, gradient drags, crop handles, heal spots. Needs the Detail view.
tool:pointer_gesture.desc: Replay a pointer gesture on the photo in normalized image coordinates (0..1, origin top-left): brush strokes, gradient drags, crop handles, heal spots. Needs the Detail view.

tool:press_key.text0: Press a key with optional modifiers (shortcuts), e.g. {key: "Z", cmd: true}. Names: A–Z, 0–9, Enter, Escape, Delete, Left/Right/Up/Down, Space, Tab, F1… .
tool:press_key.desc: Press a key with optional modifiers (shortcuts), e.g. {key: "Z", cmd: true}. Names: A–Z, 0–9, Enter, Escape, Delete, Left/Right/Up/Down, Space, Tab, F1… .

tool:query_photos.text0: List photos (id, file name, size, rating, flag, edited…). Without filter/sort: the current library view.
tool:query_photos.desc: List photos (id, file name, size, rating, flag, edited…). Without filter/sort: the current library view.

tool:render_photo.text0: Render a photo with its current develop settings (cropped) and return it as an image so you can look at the result.
tool:render_photo.desc: Render a photo with its current develop settings (cropped) and return it as an image so you can look at the result.

tool:run_command.text0: Run any LightCraft command by id with JSON params (see list_commands for ids and parameter docs), e.g. {command: "photo.rate", params: {rating: 4}}.
tool:run_command.desc: Run any LightCraft command by id with JSON params (see list_commands for ids and parameter docs), e.g. {command: "photo.rate", params: {rating: 4}}.

tool:screenshot.text0: Capture the LightCraft window (after pending renders finish) and return it as an image.
tool:screenshot.desc: Capture the LightCraft window (after pending renders finish) and return it as an image.

tool:select_photos.text0: Set the selection; the active photo (the one develop tools edit) is `active` or the first id.
tool:select_photos.desc: Set the selection; the active photo (the one develop tools edit) is `active` or the first id.

tool:set_develop.text0: Edit a photo (one undo step each for values and settings). `values` sets sliders by control id (see list_controls), e.g. {"light.exposure": 0.7, "light.contrast": 20}. `settings` deep-merges a partial develop-settings JSON (as returned by get_develop).
tool:set_develop.desc: Edit a photo (one undo step each for values and settings). `values` sets sliders by control id (see list_controls), e.g. {"light.exposure": 0.7, "light.contrast": 20}. `settings` deep-merges a partial develop-settings JSON (as returned by get_develop).

tool:set_ui.text0: Merge UI state, e.g. {"view": "detail"} (photoGrid|squareGrid|detail|compare) (see inspect_ui for fields).
tool:set_ui.desc: Merge UI state, e.g. {"view": "detail"} (photoGrid|squareGrid|detail|compare) (see inspect_ui for fields).

tool:type_text.text0: Type text into the focused field.
tool:type_text.desc: Type text into the focused field.

cmd:export.checkTarget.label: Check Output Path
cmd:export.checkTarget.params: {path} — fails when writing `path` would replace a photo's original (or its XMP sidecar) in the library; front ends call it before saving a render or screenshot to a user-given path → {path}
cmd:export.checkTarget.desc: Check that saving a render or screenshot to a path will not overwrite a library photo's original file or sidecar.

cmd:file.backupLibrary.label: Back Up Library…
cmd:file.backupLibrary.desc: Back up the entire photo library catalog to a backup.

cmd:file.restoreLibrary.label: Restore Library from Backup…
cmd:file.restoreLibrary.desc: Restore the photo library catalog from a previous backup.

cmd:library.forgetLocal.label: Forget Unchanged Local Photos
cmd:library.forgetLocal.params: {dryRun?: bool, days?: n (default: the library preference, 0 = never)} — remove Local (browsed, not added) photos nobody changed, of folders not browsed for `days`, from the catalog; files and sidecars stay, browsing the folder again brings them back; not an undo step → {local, forgotten, keptRecent, keptTouched, keptInUse, foldersStamped, days, dryRun}
cmd:library.forgetLocal.desc: Remove unchanged browsed photos from the catalog while keeping their files on disk; browsing the folder again brings them back.

cmd:library.shuffle.label: Reshuffle
cmd:library.shuffle.params: {seed?: 0..2^53-1} — sort at random; without `seed` a new shuffle each time
cmd:library.shuffle.desc: Sort the photos in a new random order, optionally repeatable with a seed.

cmd:mask.objectPoint.label: Add Object Click
cmd:mask.objectPoint.params: {x, y: normalized image point, exclude?: bool (⌥-click: leave this part out), id?: maskId} — a click on the selected mask's Object selection (its last Object component); SAM 3 re-segments the object → {include, exclude}
cmd:mask.objectPoint.desc: Add a click to an AI object mask so segmentation includes or excludes that part of the photo.

cmd:mask.refineDetail.label: Refine AI Mask Detail
cmd:mask.refineDetail.params: {id?: maskId, component?} — a zoomed-in SAM 3 pass over an Object/Describe selection (default: the mask's last one): the photo around it is analyzed again at a higher resolution, in the background; the mask updates when it's done → {started}
cmd:mask.refineDetail.desc: Re-analyze an AI object or describe mask at higher resolution in the background for finer detail.

cmd:photo.removeRegion.label: Remove Face Box
cmd:photo.removeRegion.params: {id?, index} — remove one face / pet region (by its position in the photo's regions) from the photo in the catalog; undoable. The XMP sidecar is never rewritten for this, even with auto-write on, so reading the metadata from the file brings the region back
cmd:photo.removeRegion.desc: Delete a face or pet region box from a photo in the catalog.

cmd:photo.setRegion.label: Resize Face Box
cmd:photo.setRegion.params: {id?, index, rect: {x0, y0, x1, y1}} — set one face / pet region's box (normalized, in the photo's upright frame; clamped to the photo, at least 0.5 % each way) in the catalog; undoable. Like photo.removeRegion it never rewrites the XMP sidecar
cmd:photo.setRegion.desc: Resize or reposition a face or pet region box on a photo in the catalog.

cmd:segment.model.cancel.label: Cancel AI Mask Model Download
cmd:segment.model.cancel.params: {} — stop the SAM 3 download (what has arrived is kept, and a new download resumes from it) → {cancelled}
cmd:segment.model.cancel.desc: Stop the AI mask model download; what has arrived is kept and a later download resumes from it.

cmd:segment.model.download.label: Download AI Mask Model
cmd:segment.model.download.params: {acknowledged: true} — download the SAM 3 model (about 3.4 GB, Meta's SAM License, not LightCraft's) in the background, from the configured mirrors; only after the user agreed to it. Watch segment.model.status; segment.model.cancel stops it (it resumes later) → {started, installed, downloading}
cmd:segment.model.download.desc: Download the AI mask model in the background after the user agrees to its license.

cmd:segment.model.status.label: AI Mask Model Status
cmd:segment.model.status.params: {} — whether this build has AI masks, whether the SAM 3 model is installed (and where), loaded, busy, and the download's progress → {available, installed, dir, loaded, busy, analyzing, sizeBytes, license, licenseUrl, mirrors, download: {running, done, total, file, error, finished}}
cmd:segment.model.status.desc: Show whether AI masks are available, the model's install and load state, and download progress.

cmd:segment.prepare.label: Prepare AI Masks
cmd:segment.prepare.params: {} — load SAM 3 and analyze the active photo in the background, so Object clicks are instant → {busy}
cmd:segment.prepare.desc: Load the AI model and pre-analyze the active photo so object mask clicks work instantly.

cmd:view.faceBoxes.label: Face Boxes
cmd:view.faceBoxes.desc: Show or hide the face and pet region boxes on photos in the view.

cmd:view.people.label: People
cmd:view.people.desc: Open the People view that groups photos by the people detected in them.
